atoms.a: What I like most of all is to paint people. Many of my paintings are of the people around me, like my friends and family.
I work in a hospital. I take care of sick patients and help doctors with some tasks.
I work for a company selling clothes. I work from an office, where I manage a business team.
I help people borrow books from the library. Sometimes, I recommend books to them that I think they will like.
I work in a Japanese restaurant. I prepare fish to make sushi.
I sing the songs I write. Sometimes I sing on the streets, sometimes in a cafe, and sometimes at concerts.

b.sound: My brother is a scientist. He does experiments in a lab to find out facts about nature.
My brother is a construction worker. He builds houses. He works hard and long hours.
My father is a firefighter. He mostly puts out fires, but sometimes he rescues cats stuck in trees!
My father is a police officer. He mostly catches criminals, but sometimes he rescues dogs stuck in trees!
My cousin is a waiter. He works in a fine dining restaurant. He takes the orders and serves the food.
My cousin is an athlete. He represents the country in running. He trains every day and is very fast.
My uncle is a mechanic. He repairs cars. My mum makes him repair our car for free.
My uncle is a pilot. He flies cars from London to Istanbul.
